title: L4-F3: deterministic capability ledger must use own-key membership (inherited keys bypass unknown-identity checks)
description: NON-BLOCKER from independent audit lane L4 (eshyra-o9bd.16.4 notes): deterministicCapabilityLedger.ts ~186-191, ~323-327, ~350-359 use inherited property lookups, so 'constructor', 'toString' and '__proto__' pass unknown-identity checks.
